1852 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century exception).  
Days from March 19 to end of March: 12 days (March has 31 days).  
Remaining days after March: 168 - 12 = 156 days.  
April (30) → 126 left, May (31) → 95 left, June (30) → 65 left,  
July (31) → 34 left, August (31) → 3 left.  
3 days into September → September 3, 1852.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1852-09-03
